messages:
maya patel: Heads-up — deploying model-route v2 to canary in quiet window now. Plan is gradual FF ramp for `route.v2_enabled` starting 1%.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued (ID: db-7753). ETA 02:15 UTC. Auto-healthchecks enabled.

sam wilson: ack. Ramp proposal: 1% -> 5% after 10m -> 20% after 30m -> 50% after 60m -> 100% after stable 2h. Rollback if error rate >0.5% or p95 latency +100ms.

jordan lee: also pin traffic to `model-v1-stable` for persist connections on rollback. Set version pin TTL=30m.

alex choi: Can we add auto-sla rule in `deploy-bot`? e.g., `on_failure: rollback_to model-v1-stable` and `monitor: p95_latency, error_rate` — I'll push the quick PR to deploy config.

maya patel: adding the manual holdpoint at 50% so oncall can pause if telemetry noisy. @sam can you own 30m and 60m checks?

sam wilson: yep will watch dashboards. I'll post status at each step. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 1% (instances: 4). Healthchecks passing 2/2.

jordan lee: quick note: KV cache warmup might take ~5m — expect a small latency bump. We should ignore brief spike under 2m.

maya patel: agreed — include warmup window in release notes. Also bump tracing sampling for this window.

sam wilson: status: 5% after 12m — p95 +30ms, errors flat. progressing to 20% in 18m.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 20% scheduled. Next holdpoint at 50%.

alex choi: PR merged for auto-rollback rule. config snippet: ```yaml
on_failure: rollback
criteria:
  - metric: error_rate
    threshold: 0.5
  - metric: p95_latency
    delta_ms: 100
rollback_to: model-v1-stable
``` 

maya patel: if we see oscillation between 20-50% we throttle and hold. @jordan prepare flag pin script:
`curl -X POST https://internal-redwood/flags/pin -d '{"flag":"route.v2_enabled","version":"model-v1-stable","ttl":1800}'`

sam wilson: all right — 50% holdpoint reached, metrics look green. Moving to 100% in 2h unless anything blocks.

jordan lee: ready to execute pin if needed. oncall alerted.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete: model-route v2 at 100% traffic. No rollbacks triggered. Release notes updated: "Canary -> Prod for model-route v2; gradual feature flag ramp; auto-rollback rules added." 

maya patel: thanks team. I'll file a quick postmortem checklist item to review warmup tuning and SLA thresholds.

sam wilson: nice. :tada:
